name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: 1b. Expresses deep concern about the risk of further military escalation in the Red Sea and the wider Middle East, fuelled in particular by the Israeli genocide in Gaza and the criminal attacks by Israel and the United States against Iran; calls on all relevant actors to exercise restraint, refrain from actions that could widen the conflict and pursue diplomatic solutions; stresses that military responses cannot provide a sustainable solution to the security challenges facing the region;
